column.text: Bitcoin is currently trading above the critical seventy-eight thousand dollar resistance level after a violent short liquidation cascade forced prices higher today. The tape screams bullish conviction with an institutional footprint that dwarfs retail noise. Spot ETFs absorbed two hundred and sixteen million dollars of net inflows while MicroStrategy quietly added another four thousand six hundred three bitcoins to its treasury, pushing total holdings past eight hundred forty-five thousand coins. Simultaneously, BitMine acquired fifty-three thousand five hundred one ethers for a combined thirteen-one-million-dollar investment in their digital asset reserves. This massive accumulation creates a formidable floor beneath the price action even as retail sentiment sits firmly at sixty-nine on the fear and greed index indicating pure greed territory. The technicals confirm this strength with daily relative strength indices hovering near seventy-one suggesting momentum is intact rather than exhausted. However, traders must remain vigilant regarding macroeconomic headwinds specifically concerning potential Federal Reserve rate hikes which carry a fifty-six percent probability of occurring post-meeting. Such an event could trigger a sudden rotation out of risk assets despite the current dollar liquidity remaining flat and offering no clear tailwind or headwind for price discovery. The market structure is currently driven by social trading volume approaching one point three billion dollars weekly on-chain rather than organic fundamental shifts alone. While continuation longs hold significant momentum carry, any counter-trend shorting requires a specific mechanism like overheated funding rates or a failed breakout to justify entry into such strength.
